text: No ruin keeps this tablet. The Unsung carries it, and gives it up when it falls; hang it on a wall to read it.
In the Seal-carvers' own words, cut as carefully as a seal:

“Spirit goes where it is asked politely and stays where it is fed. A seal is a polite request carved in stone. A brazier is the meal. We cut blank seals by the thousand before the Cut, and asked for far too much. Ask for a little. Feed it well.”
